items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Young fired him in Tampa, Florida. That's where we left him, in Tampa. ... So Mr. Young got this show together, and that's the time that we did marching. ... That's when I left Mr. Young; I was getting ready to leave him.

ctx.x: Now, you mentioned Dirty Red from the carnival show. Tell us a little bit about him. He was a blues singer, right?

A blues singer, yeah, and a dancer -- and a comedian; he told jokes and things. But he could sing the blues real good. He got fired. Mr. Young fired him in Tampa, Florida. That's where we left him, in Tampa.
